title: Scrimmage startup report, version 2
description: What a service process answers the runner's signed probe with: how it was started and what its gates found before any run, and whether it could reach the control server. It holds no token, no plan and nothing of a run.

v.description: The report's version. Version 1 had no `control`.

sdk.description: The version of scrimmage-core in the service, which the runner compares with its own: another major is refused, another minor or patch is allowed with a warning.

python.description: The service's Python, as `sys.version` gives it.

executable.description: The path of the service's Python, with any secret in it removed.

mode.description: How the SDK runs in this process.

gates.description: The entry gates installed in this process, such as `asgi` for uvicorn and `starlette`.

libraries.description: Each gated library the service has imported, and its version.

chained_sitecustomize.description: True when the sitecustomize Python loaded is not Scrimmage's, as when the service has one of its own earlier on its path.

tools.description: The names the model sees for the tools SCRIMMAGE_TOOLS names, sorted.

notices.description: Notices a gate gave with no run open, such as a library too new or missing what a gate needs.

control.description: The service's signed ping to the control server, sent before it answered.

server_time.description: The service's clock when it answered, in seconds since the epoch.

notice.description: One notice given with no run.

library.description: The library it is about, or `scrimmage`.

message.description: What it says, as stderr printed it.

control.description: What the ping found. A field it does not list fits: a later Scrimmage may add one, and a reader ignores it.

reached.description: True when the control server answered the ping.

tls.description: `verified` for an https control URL whose certificate was accepted, `none` for http on loopback, on a failure over https the class of the error, such as `SSLCertVerificationError`, or `not connected` when no ping was tried because every control slot was busy.

error.description: For a ping that failed to connect, the class name of the error, such as `TimeoutError`, `ConnectionRefusedError`, `gaierror` or `SSLCertVerificationError`, on `http://` and `https://` alike. `ControlError` when the control server's reply was not signed for the request or was not valid. `null` when the ping was answered, when the control server answered with an error, and when no ping was tried. Optional: a report from an older Scrimmage has none.

detail.description: For a failure, the error's message with any secret removed, cut at 200 characters. `null` when the ping was answered.

rtt_ms.description: The ping's round trip in milliseconds.

runner_id.description: The id the control server answered with, or `null`. The runner checks it is its own.

url.description: The control address the service was started with, as scheme, host and port.
